mapper.select: SELECT scene_id, scene_type FROM bt_bot_scene WHERE status_cd = '00A' AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND scene_id IN (#{sceneId})

SELECT a.scene_id, a.scene_name, a.prologue FROM bt_bot_scene a WHERE a.status_cd = '00A' AND a.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND a.scene_status = #{query.sceneStatus}
AND lower(a.scene_name) LIKE
lower(#{query.searchContent})
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bt_bot_scene_rel r WHERE a.scene_id = r.scene_id AND a.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND r.status_cd = '00A' AND r.bot_id = #{query.botId}) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bt_label b, bt_label_object_rel r WHERE b.label_id = r.label_id AND b.label_type = 'scene' AND b.label_name in (#{label}) AND r.status_cd = '00A' AND r.object_id = a.scene_id AND r.tenant_id = a.tenant_id)

SELECT a.scene_id, a.scene_name, a.scene_type, a.scene_desc, a.prologue, a.flow_step_json, a.model_id, a.model_config_json, a.long_term_memory_enabled, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bt_label b JOIN bt_label_object_rel r ON r.label_id = b.label_id WHERE b.status_cd = '00A' AND b.label_type = 'scene' AND b.label_name = #{jumpLabelName} AND r.status_cd = '00A' AND r.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND r.object_id = a.scene_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS jump_enabled, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bt_label b JOIN bt_label_object_rel r ON r.label_id = b.label_id WHERE b.status_cd = '00A' AND b.label_type = 'scene' AND b.label_name = #{autoStartLabelName} AND r.status_cd = '00A' AND r.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND r.object_id = a.scene_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS auto_start_enabled, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bt_label b JOIN bt_label_object_rel r ON r.label_id = b.label_id WHERE b.status_cd = '00A' AND b.label_type = 'scene' AND b.label_name = #{confirmLabelName} AND r.status_cd = '00A' AND r.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND r.object_id = a.scene_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirm_enabled FROM bt_bot_scene a WHERE a.scene_id = #{sceneId} AND a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.status_cd = '00A'
AND a.scene_status = #{sceneStatus}

SELECT a.scene_id, a.scene_name, a.scene_type, a.scene_desc, a.prologue, a.flow_step_json, a.model_id, a.model_config_json, a.long_term_memory_enabled, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bt_label b JOIN bt_label_object_rel r ON r.label_id = b.label_id WHERE b.status_cd = '00A' AND b.label_type = 'scene' AND b.label_name = #{jumpLabelName} AND r.status_cd = '00A' AND r.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND r.object_id = a.scene_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS jump_enabled, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bt_label b JOIN bt_label_object_rel r ON r.label_id = b.label_id WHERE b.status_cd = '00A' AND b.label_type = 'scene' AND b.label_name = #{autoStartLabelName} AND r.status_cd = '00A' AND r.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND r.object_id = a.scene_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS auto_start_enabled, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bt_label b JOIN bt_label_object_rel r ON r.label_id = b.label_id WHERE b.status_cd = '00A' AND b.label_type = 'scene' AND b.label_name = #{confirmLabelName} AND r.status_cd = '00A' AND r.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND r.object_id = a.scene_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirm_enabled FROM bt_bot_scene a WHERE a.scene_id IN (#{sceneId}) AND a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.status_cd = '00A'
AND a.scene_status = #{sceneStatus}

SELECT a.scene_id, a.scene_name, a.scene_desc FROM bt_bot_scene a WHERE a.status_cd = '00A' AND a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.scene_status = '1' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bt_label b JOIN bt_label_object_rel r ON r.label_id = b.label_id WHERE b.status_cd = '00A' AND b.label_type = 'scene' AND b.label_name IN (#{id}) AND r.status_cd = '00A' AND r.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND r.object_id = a.scene_id)

SELECT a.scene_id, a.scene_name, a.scene_desc FROM bt_bot_scene a LEFT JOIN bt_bot_scene_rel b ON a.scene_id = b.scene_id AND a.tenant_id = b.tenant_id WHERE a.status_cd = '00A' AND b.status_cd = '00A' AND a.scene_status = '1' AND b.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND b.bot_id = #{botId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bt_label c JOIN bt_label_object_rel r ON r.label_id = c.label_id WHERE c.status_cd = '00A' AND c.label_type = 'scene' AND c.label_name IN (#{id}) AND r.status_cd = '00A' AND r.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND r.object_id = a.scene_id)

SELECT a.scene_id, a.scene_name, a.scene_desc, c.bot_id FROM bt_bot_scene a LEFT JOIN bt_bot_scene_rel r ON r.scene_id = a.scene_id AND r.tenant_id = a.tenant_id LEFT JOIN bt_bot c ON c.bot_id = r.bot_id AND c.tenant_id = r.tenant_id WHERE a.status_cd = '00A' AND r.status_cd = '00A' AND c.status_cd = '00A' AND a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.scene_status = '1' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bt_label b JOIN bt_label_object_rel r ON r.label_id = b.label_id WHERE b.status_cd = '00A' AND b.label_type = 'scene' AND b.label_name IN (#{id}) AND r.status_cd = '00A' AND r.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND r.object_id = a.scene_id)
